record_title: Generalized chi permutations collapse to parallel odd chi blocks
provenance: A structural consequence of the shift-cycle decomposition in the quadratic permutation family classified by Feng--Wang--Yu--Zhang, combined with known exact invariants of the ordinary odd-dimensional chi map due to Kriepke--Kyureghyan and earlier inverse work.
limitations: The result applies only to the quadratic shift-invariant family classified in arXiv:2609.19548v1. Iteration dynamics transfer only for the two explicit conjugate families, not arbitrary two-sided affine-equivalent representatives. The decomposition is elementary once the shift cycles are isolated, so folklore and near-simultaneous priority risk are material.
